{{Quote|Saber Shura will take you to the Circle Chambers.|A female Sith Saber, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="OM" />}}
'''Shura''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sith Saber]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] from the remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. In [[41 ABY]], [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]] was summoned to the [[Circle of Lords]]. When the Tyro arrived, Shura took Khai to the [[Circle Chambers]], the room where the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] convened.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I am Tyro Vestara Khai. I was summoned.|Vestara Khai, upon meeting Shura and the two other Sabers|<ref name="OM" />}}
[[File:Kesh_from_space.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Shura was native to Kesh (pictured).]]
Shura was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was born on the remote<ref name="OM" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] and lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]]. She was [[Sith training|trained]] by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]<ref name="OM" />&mdash;descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on Kesh during the days of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Precipice]]''</ref>&mdash;and,<ref name="OM" /> by [[41 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' to [[41 ABY]].</ref> had ascended to the rank of [[Sith Saber]]. During that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on Kesh. The Sphere developed a strong connection in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] with the [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]], resulting in Khai being summoned to the [[Circle of Lords]], the governing body of the tribe, in [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Kesh.<ref name="OM" />

Shura, together with a [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Kesh)|male]] and a [[Unidentified dark-skinned Sith Saber|female]] Sith Saber, awaited Khai at the [[Kesh capitol building|capitol building]] in Tahv. When Khai arrived, Shura took Khai to the [[Circle Chambers]], the room in which the Circle of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lords]] convened, via a winding staircase. Upon reaching the top of the stairs, Shura used the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|open]] the entrance to the chambers.<ref name="OM" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Follow me.|Shura, to Vestara Khai|<ref name="OM" />}}
Upon first meeting Khai, Shura examined the young Tyro evenly, and when the Sith Tyro bowed before the three Sabers, Shura acknowledged her with a nod. After being introduced to the Tyro, she ordered Khai to follow her and led her to the Circle Chambers without further ceremony.<ref name="OM" />

==Powers and abilities==
Shura possessed the [[Force power/Legends|abilities]] required to achieve the rank of Sith Saber and was strong enough in telekinesis to open the entrance to the Circle Chambers, which was hidden in a stone wall at the top of the capitol building. Khai was unable to feel Shura's presence in the Force until she heard the sound of the [[Boot/Legends|boots]] of the three approaching Sabers.<ref name="OM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shura appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', written by [[Christie Golden]].<ref name="OM" />
